items.item_text: At least four (4) years of experience demonstrating the ability to apply the techniques of the trade
Repair and open locks, make keys, and change lock combinations using hand tools and special equipment.
Cut new or duplicate keys, using key cutting machine.
Install locks and hardware for replacement and minor alteration projects.
Design keying systems for individual buildings and college systems as a whole.
Specify hardware requirements for the new buildings.
Maintain computer database of locks and keying codes for the Colleges.
Comply with OSHA, Cal/OSHA and other applicable regulatory safety rules and ensure personnel comply in the performance of assigned work.
Use blueprints, sketches, shop drawings, specifications and related technical data lay out and coordinate work performance of the trade.
Maintain as-built drawings of work undertaken to depict actual construction variances from design drawings.
From blueprints and/or general guidance, assist in preparing material take-offs and labor estimates.
Collaborate with fellow locksmiths and facilities personnel.
Perform other work in general category of Physical Plant Maintenance, repair and alterations as assigned by the Lead or Supervisor.
